Existing draft PR #261 remains unmerged and locally owned.

BetterInstincts decision_horizon and activity_chain are established pure planning owners; host preference executor currently has player-first single-button guard. This scoped stacked branch protects the local agent's draft branch and composes on top of it.

p82_experiment_admission.hypothesis: A different selected Sim cannot contaminate recipient Yes/No decisions, the same continuation plan and recipient needs/deadlines gate both choices, stale/missing values HOLD, and a catalog row alone never authorizes response.
p82_experiment_admission.baseline: PR #261 currently uses topic catalog or optional per-choice steps keyed to selected sim_ref.
p82_experiment_admission.comparator: Recipient ID and live source-gated snapshot + same continuation sequence and bounded branch effect overlays.
measurements: No auto decision from catalog-only row

p82_experiment_admission.decision_rule: Source CI can prove pure comparator behavior; P08 blocked until native EA offer-recipient observation, effect prediction calibration, response, post-modal activity restoration and rollback are shown in Sims.
